name: Chandrayaan-3 (Statio Shiv Shakti)

outcomeDetail.summary: Soft-landed with the Pragyan rover. Designed for one lunar day (about 14 Earth days); the rover and lander were put to sleep on 2 and 4 Sep 2023 and never answered again.

sources.label: Tribune India (PTI), ISRO attempt to wake Chandrayaan-3 lander and rover

source.label: ISRO, Chandrayaan-3 details
source.note: ISRO's planned prime landing site, 359 m from where Vikram actually landed

blurb: Solar-powered and built for one lunar day; it went to sleep as night fell and never woke.

sources.label: LROC RDR shapefile, Anthropogenic Features on the Moon (last updated 2026-08-14)

notes: Coordinates taken from the LROC anthropogenic shapefile (2026-08-14), which gives more decimals; previous value -69.3741, 32.32 moved 14 m.
Elevation = shapefile RADIUS (NAC DTM) minus 1,737,400 m.
ISRO's pre-landing estimate: powered descent 'around 1745 Hrs. IST'. The exact touchdown time is unsourced from a primary.
